verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for an API platform with a dashboard and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry or usage-tracking controls, let alone an opt-out. SOC 2 / PCI compliance is a security certification, not a user-facing opt-out, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
